3. Line 24: `extractFileIfIncluded(tmp1, tmp2, in, tmp3, ...)` - Here `in` is passed as the 4th argument
4. Line 31: `final tmp8 = resolveSymlink(zf, ze);` - This creates tmp8 from the resolveSymlink function call

The key point is that `in` is used as a parameter to `extractFileIfIncluded` at line 24, and `tmp8` is also used as a parameter to the same function at line 32. `extractFileIfIncluded(tmp1, tmp2, in, tmp3, ..., tmp4, tmp5, new Date(tmp4), tmp5, ..., tmp6 != 0 ? tmp6 : null, tmp8)`

The value of `in` (which was set at line 19) is completely independent of the value of `tmp8` (which is set at line 31). The variable `in` is assigned from `zf.getInputStream(ze)` and is not affected by or dependent on the `resolveSymlink` function call that produces `tmp8`.
